title: Sky Watcher operators differ from legacy programs

tellings.quote: Granted, this is not what Jake's team does. The operators he has on this team do not do what may these legacy programs do. It's completely different.

plain: The team at Sky Watcher, a group run by a man named Jake Barber, does not do what the older secret government UFO programs do; its operators work in a completely different way. Michael Herrera, who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle, passes this on from what Barber has told him. It matters because it sets Barber's team apart from the hidden programs it might otherwise be compared to.
